024
025public class PlanetExplosionScript implements EveryFrameScript {
026
027        protected boolean done = false;
028        protected boolean playedWindup = false;
029        
030        protected SectorEntityToken explosion = null;
031        protected boolean setLavaPlanetTex = false;
032        protected float delay = 0.5f;
033        protected float delay2 = 1f;
034        protected float elapsed = 0f;
035        protected boolean changedType = false;
036        
037        protected PlanetAPI planet;
038        protected transient SoundAPI windup = null;
039        
040        
041        
042        public PlanetExplosionScript(PlanetAPI planet) {
043                this.planet = planet;
044                
045                delay = 1.2f;
046                
047                PlanetSpecAPI lava = null;
048                PlanetSpecAPI minor = null;
049                for (PlanetSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllPlanetSpecs()) {
050                        if (spec.getPlanetType().equals(Planets.PLANET_LAVA)) {
051                                lava = spec;
052                        }
053                        if (spec.getPlanetType().equals(Planets.PLANET_LAVA_MINOR)) {
054                                minor = spec;
055                        }
056                }
057                if (lava != null) {
058                        planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture(lava.getTexture());
059                        if (minor != null) planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture2(minor.getTexture());
060                        planet.getSpec().setShieldThickness(0.001f);
061                        planet.getSpec().setShieldColor(new Color(255,255,255,0));
062                        planet.applySpecChanges();
063                }
064                
065                Global.getSector().addScript(this);
066                
067
068                MarketAPI market = planet.getMarket();
069                if (!market.isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) {
070                        DecivTracker.removeColony(market, false);
071                        SDResolution.cleanUpFleetsAffectedByPlanetOrFactionDestruction();
072                }
073                planet.addTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE);
074                
075        }
076        
077        protected Object readResolve() {
078                return this;
079        }
080
081
082        public void advance(float amount) {
083                if (done) return;
084                
085                elapsed += amount;
086                
087                float maxDur = 25f;
088                
089                float b = elapsed / maxDur;
090                
091                boolean explode = false;
092                if (b < 0.75f) {
093                        b = b / 0.75f;
094                } else {
095                        if (!changedType) {
096                                float tilt = planet.getSpec().getTilt();
097                                float pitch = planet.getSpec().getPitch();
098                                //planet.changeType(Planets.PLANET_LAVA_MINOR, Misc.random);
099                                planet.changeType(Planets.PLANET_LAVA, Misc.random);
100                                planet.getSpec().setTilt(tilt);
101                                planet.getSpec().setPitch(pitch);
102                                
103                                PlanetSpecAPI lava = null;
104                                PlanetSpecAPI minor = null;
105                                for (PlanetSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllPlanetSpecs()) {
106                                        if (spec.getPlanetType().equals(Planets.PLANET_LAVA)) {
107                                                lava = spec;
108                                        }
109                                        if (spec.getPlanetType().equals(Planets.PLANET_LAVA_MINOR)) {
110                                                minor = spec;
111                                        }
112                                }
113                                if (lava != null) {
114                                        planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture(lava.getTexture());
115                                        if (minor != null) planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture2(minor.getTexture());
116                                        planet.getSpec().setShieldThickness(0.001f);
117                                        planet.getSpec().setShieldColor(new Color(255,255,255,0));
118                                }
119                                
120                                planet.applySpecChanges();
121                                changedType = true;
122                                explode = true;
123                        }
124                        b = 1f - (b - 0.75f) / 0.25f;
125                }
126                
127                if (b < 0f) b = 0f;
128                if (b > 1f) b = 1f;
129
130                
131                if (explosion == null && amount > 0) {
132                        float untilWindup = maxDur * 0.75f - elapsed;
133                        float windupDur = Global.getSettings().getFloat("planetExplosionWindupDur");
134                        if (untilWindup <= windupDur && (!playedWindup || windup == null)) {
135                                if (planet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
136                                        windup = Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("planet_explosion_windup", 1f, 1f, planet.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
137                                }
138                                playedWindup = true;
139                        }
140                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playLoop("planet_explosion_loop", planet, 0.25f + b * 0.75f, 1f, planet.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
141                }               
142                
143
144                if (b > 0.85f) b = 0.85f;
145                //if (b > 0.95f) b = 0.3f + 0.7f * (1f - b) / 0.05f;
146                
147                float bOrig = b;
148                b = Math.min(b * 2f, 1f);
149                b *= 0.2f;
150                int a = (int)(b * 255f);
151                if (a > 255) a = 255;
152
153                float bExtra = 0f;
154                if (bOrig > 0.75f) {
155                        bExtra = (bOrig - 0.75f) / 0.25f;
156                }
157                //bExtra = bOrig * bOrig;
158                int aExtra = (int)(bExtra * 255f);
159                if (aExtra > 255) aExtra = 255; 
160                
161                planet.getSpec().setShieldColor(new Color(255,255,255,aExtra));
162                planet.getSpec().setShieldColor2(new Color(255,255,255,a));
163                
164                
165                float maxJitter = 50f;
166                int numJitter = (int)(20 * bOrig);
167                numJitter = 7;
168                float maxExpand = maxJitter / planet.getRadius();
169                maxExpand *= 0.25f;
170                planet.getSpec().setShieldThickness(0.001f + maxExpand * bOrig);
171                planet.getSpec().setShieldThickness2(0.001f + maxExpand * bOrig);
172                
173//              if (bOrig > 0.9f && !setLavaPlanetTex) {
174//                      setLavaPlanetTex = true;
175//                      for (PlanetSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllPlanetSpecs()) {
176//                              if (spec.getPlanetType().equals(Planets.PLANET_LAVA)) {
177//                                      planet.getSpec().setTexture(spec.getTexture());
178//                                      break;
179//                              }
180//                      }       
181//              }
182                
183                planet.applySpecChanges();
184                
185                
186                float angVelExtra = bOrig * bOrig * 360f;
187                float angle = planet.getAngle();
188                angle += angVelExtra * amount;
189                planet.setAngle(angle);
190                
191                planet.advance(amount);
192                planet.setShieldTextureJitter(bOrig * maxJitter, numJitter);
193                
194                if (elapsed > maxDur) {
195                        planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture(null);
196                        planet.getSpec().setShieldTexture2(null);
197                        planet.applySpecChanges();
198                        planet.setShieldTextureJitter(0, 0);
199
200                        done = true;
201                }
202                
203                if (explode) {
204                        MarketAPI market = planet.getMarket();
205                        if (!market.isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) {
206                                for (SectorEntityToken curr : market.getConnectedEntities()) {
207                                        if (!(curr instanceof PlanetAPI)) {
208                                                curr.getContainingLocation().removeEntity(curr);
209                                        }
210                                }
211                        }
212                        planet.removeTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE);
213                        
214                        planet.setCustomDescriptionId("planet_sindria_exploded");
215                        planet.setCustomInteractionDialogImageVisual(null);
216                        
217                        if (windup != null && windup.isPlaying()) {
218                                windup.stop();
219                        }
220                        
221                        LocationAPI cl = planet.getContainingLocation();
222                        Vector2f loc = planet.getLocation();
223                        Vector2f vel = planet.getVelocity();
224
225                        float size = planet.getRadius() + 250f;
226                        Color color = new Color(255, 165, 100);
227                        ExplosionParams params = new ExplosionParams(color, cl, loc, size, 2f);
228                        params.baseSizeMult = 2.5f;
229                        params.initialRadiusMult = 3f;
230                        params.initialHitGlowMult = 5f;
231                        params.particleNumMult = 6f;
232                        params.useInitialSqrtParticleDistribution = true;
233                        params.explosionSoundId = "planet_explosion";
234                        params.damage = ExplosionFleetDamage.EXTREME;
235
236                        explosion = cl.addCustomEntity(Misc.genUID(), "Sindria Explosion", 
237                                        Entities.EXPLOSION, Factions.NEUTRAL, params);
238                        explosion.setLocation(loc.x, loc.y);
239                        
240                }
241        }
242        
243        public boolean isDone() {
244                return done;
245        }
246
247        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
248                return false;
249        }
250        
251}
